title: Deploy decision
description: Based on what you have seen, decide whether you would deploy this policy on a real robot, and how confident you are.

metadata.instrument: Study-defined behavioural-intention measure. Not a published scale.
metadata.note: The deploy decision is a key dependent variable; capture it BEFORE revealing the objective success rate.

items.prompt: Would you deploy this policy on a real robot to do the task?
How confident are you in this decision?
Out of 10 attempts, how many do you think the robot would complete successfully?
